translations.web: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
translations.bsb: Then the angel added, “I will greatly multiply your offspring so that they will be too numerous to count.”
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
translations.asv: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, I will greatly multiply thy seed, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
